changelog.release_notes:
AirCheck v1.3.1

- Added United States and European AQI scale selection.
- Added optional fixed-location lookup by city or postal code and country code.
- Added native Diorite, Emery, Flint, and Gabbro builds.
- Added scale-aware AQI guidance and native high-resolution layouts.

AirCheck 1.2

- Added Celsius/Fahrenheit toggle in Settings
- Fixed issue where unit changes didn’t apply
- Simplified temperature handling for better reliability

No changes to AQI or recommendation logic.

hardware_platforms.name: aplite
hardware_platforms.description:
AirCheck gives you a fast, simple answer to one question:
should you go outside right now?

Using real-time air quality (AQI) and weather data, AirCheck gives you a simple, instant recommendation:

GO OUT
CAUTION
STAY IN

Features
- Real-time AQI and weather courtesy of Open-Meteo
- Temperature-aware recommendations
- Thunderstorm safety override
- Clear reason text explaining each recommendation
- Simple, easy-to-read interface
- Manual refresh on launch and button press
- Works across all Pebble watch types

No clutter. No confusing settings. Just a clear answer when you need it.

changelog.release_notes:
Mini METAR Pebble v1.1.0

New:

Automatic weather refresh now initiated by the watch every 5 minutes.
More reliable operation on original Pebble and Pebble Steel devices.
Fixed:

Configuration page restored and deployed with the website.
Corrected weather age/status display.
Improved communication between watch and PebbleKit JS.
General stability improvements.

## Mini METAR v1.0.0

Initial public release!

Mini METAR brings current aviation weather (METAR) directly to your Pebble watch.

### Features

- Live METAR weather for any ICAO airport
- Configurable airport selection
- Save up to 10 favorite airports
- Flight category display (VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR)
- Temperature in °F or °C
- Altimeter in inHg or hPa
- Wind direction and speed
- Observation time and METAR age
- Manual and automatic weather refresh
- Support for Pebble Steel, Pebble Time, Pebble Time Steel, Pebble 2, Pebble Round, and compatible Rebble devices

Thank you for trying Mini METAR! Feedback, bug reports, and feature requests are always welcome.

hardware_platforms.name: aplite
hardware_platforms.description:
Mini METAR brings current aviation weather directly to your Pebble smartwatch. View live METAR information for any ICAO airport, including flight category, temperature, wind, altimeter setting, and observation time.

Configure your preferred airport, save up to 10 favorite airports for quick access, choose between Fahrenheit or Celsius and inHg or hPa, and refresh weather manually or automatically.

Designed for pilots, aviation enthusiasts, and anyone who wants quick access to airport weather from their wrist. Compatible with Pebble and Rebble-supported devices, including Pebble Steel, Pebble Time, Pebble Time Steel, Pebble 2, Pebble Round, and other supported models.
